name: OneDrive (Personal) Storage Destination
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Back up containers to a personal OneDrive account (consumer endpoint). Talks to Microsoft Graph /me/drive for upload/download/delete/list and login.microsoftonline.com/consumers for OAuth tokens. 1.0.4: embedded McSparrow-owned Azure AD app registration is now a real client_id (10c8115f-452f-48b1-9d5b-878ce7e243eb) — no Azure AD setup required for the default experience. Public-client / Mobile-and-desktop-app flow, no client_secret needed.
